Still reads plain: all items are untextured boxes and the middle third of the floor is empty.
round_28_fixes_checked.3 club: landed: a light truss with spotlights over the floor, raised stage with steps, a booth and high tables in view, the back wall broken into panels, a bar with a neon edge. The ADULTS ONLY sign exists on the sheet but no bouncer post or sign is visible in the club evidence.
round_28_fixes_checked.4 arcade: landed: more cabinets, a PRIZES counter, a sit-down racer cabinet with a red seat for Prism Shift, neon floor arrows, stools and a table. The racer cabinet stands out from the uprights.

round_28_fixes_checked.6 cafe: landed: cakes on stands in the window, three menu boards, an A-frame sign.
